problem.title: Encoding Validator
problem.statement: Given two strings, determine if they are isomorphic (can be mapped one-to-one from the first character set to the second). For example, "egg" and "add" are isomorphic because e->a, g->d.
problem.hint: For each character pair at the same position, ensure the mapping is consistent. If e is already mapped to a, then e cannot map to anything else.
problem.walkthrough:
Example s = "egg", t = "add".

e -> a: save mapping e->a.
g -> d: save mapping g->d.
g -> d: mapping g->d already exists, match!

All consistent, answer: isomorphic.

Key insight: two hash maps are needed: one for s->t mapping, one for t->s mapping.
